t: Learn About Atlanta's 6 Zones - What Does This Mean? — Justin Landis Group
s: September 16, 2024 - For starters, each zone has its own character and attractions - and it gives the city a unique and different feel. That means you can have a different experience depending on which part of the city you're in. Also, it helps local authorities manage the city more effectively. This zoning system is like a map for how the city works, which makes sure everything runs smoothly. Let's dig into this a little more! Atlanta is split into six zones, each one having its own neighborhoods and features.

Urban Enterprise Zone
s: An “Urban Enterprise Zone” (UEZ) is a designated district that is located within an economically-depressed area of the City where property owners receive tax abatements over a ten- year period, if certain conditions are met. Visit the City of Atlanta’s website for additional information about the Urban Enterprise Zone program as well as the appropriate applications.
